name: Black Obsidian
description: Volcanic glass with a mirror-like polish. Obsidian is traditionally worn as a shield and for the honesty to see what needs releasing.
mineral: Obsidian is natural volcanic glass, formed when lava cools too fast for crystals to grow. That is why it breaks with smooth, curved edges instead of flat faces.
foundIn: Mexico, the United States and Iceland
wornFor: A black obsidian bracelet is traditionally worn for protection, honesty and letting go of what no longer fits. Obsidian is a root chakra stone linked with Scorpio and Sagittarius, and it is often chosen as a first protection piece because it is simple, polished and entirely black. Its glassy surface scratches more easily than quartz, so store it in its pouch away from other jewellery.
wristWhy: Wear black obsidian on the right wrist. Tradition treats the right side as the one that projects, so protective stones sit there as a boundary facing outward.
